title: Sort Stack
description: Pour matching top rings between poles, undo mistakes and solve five increasingly complex sorting puzzles.
controls: Tap a source pole, then a target pole. Only matching top colors can stack. Tap Undo to reverse a move.

zh-CN.title: 色环归位
zh-CN.description: 点选起点再点终点，将同色圆环归到一柱，支持撤销，90秒挑战由易到难的五关。
zh-CN.controls: 点起点柱再点终点柱，同色才能叠放，空柱可接任意颜色；点击撤销回退一步。
